description: This file contains functions and types for managing the spawning of ACP (Agent Control Plane) sessions, including session initialization, thread binding, policy validation, and communication with a gateway. It handles spawning new agent sessions, binding threads, and managing related runtime and session state.

methods.name: resolveAcpSpawnRuntimePolicyError
methods.description: Determines if spawning an ACP session violates runtime policies, especially regarding sandboxing and runtime environment.

methods.name: resolveSpawnMode
methods.description: Determines the spawn mode ('run' or 'session') based on requested mode and thread binding.

methods.name: resolveAcpSessionMode
methods.description: Converts spawn mode to session mode ('persistent' or 'oneshot').

methods.name: isHeartbeatEnabledForSessionAgent
methods.description: Checks if heartbeat is enabled for a session agent based on configuration and policy.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatConfigForAgent
methods.description: Resolves heartbeat configuration for a specific agent.

methods.name: hasSessionLocalHeartbeatRelayRoute
methods.description: Determines if a session has a local heartbeat relay route.

methods.name: resolveTargetAcpAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the target agent ID for spawning, based on request or default configuration.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalAgentId
methods.description: Normalizes and trims an optional agent ID string.

methods.name: summarizeError
methods.description: Converts an error object or string into a concise message.

methods.name: createAcpSpawnFailure
methods.description: Creates a standardized failure result for spawn attempts.

methods.name: isMissingPathError
methods.description: Checks if an error is related to missing filesystem paths.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeCwdForAcpSpawn
methods.description: Resolves the current working directory for an ACP spawn, verifying its existence.

methods.name: resolveRequesterInternalSessionKey
methods.description: Generates an internal session key for the requester based on configuration and provided session key.

methods.name: persistAcpSpawnSessionFileBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to persist session state to a transcript file, with error handling.

methods.name: resolveConversationIdForThreadBinding
methods.description: Resolves the conversation ID for thread binding based on channel and target info.

methods.name: resolveAcpSpawnChannelAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID for a channel, with fallback to default.

methods.name: prepareAcpThreadBinding
methods.description: Prepares thread binding parameters, validating capabilities and conversation IDs.

methods.name: resolveAcpSpawnRequesterState
methods.description: Resolves the state of the spawn requester, including session, heartbeat, and context info.

methods.name: resolveAcpSpawnStreamPlan
methods.description: Determines whether to stream output to parent based on spawn mode and context.

methods.name: initializeAcpSpawnRuntime
methods.description: Initializes the runtime environment for a new ACP session, including session management.

methods.name: bindPreparedAcpThread
methods.description: Binds a prepared thread to a session, creating necessary session entries and bindings.

methods.name: resolveAcpSpawnBootstrapDeliveryPlan
methods.description: Determines delivery parameters for bootstrap output of a spawned session.

methods.name: spawnAcpDirect
methods.description: Main function to spawn an ACP session, handling policy checks, session creation, thread binding, and communication.
